result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow sidewalk on only one side of the street and a complete lack of marked crossings at the visible intersection. The wide, unmarked roadway and lack of traffic calming measures create a space that prioritizes vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked lanes without priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the mid-ground where the stop signs are located

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk network
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved grass.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide road surface can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks and curb ramps at the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for all users.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Apply paint to define travel lanes, which can help reduce vehicle speeds by narrowing the perceived roadway width.

result.summary: The image shows a continuous concrete sidewalk adjacent to a fenced playground. While the walkway is in good condition, there is no physical buffer such as trees or parked cars between the pedestrian path and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential street with a paved sidewalk and grass buffer on the left side, adjacent to a park or recreational area. The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, and there are no marked crosswalks or traffic calming features visible. Parked vehicles, including a large van, create significant visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the unmarked roadway.
